subject: social-studies
title: Water Supply: From Rain to Tap, Stage by Stage Exit Ticket

questions.prompt: A student says Tap water is clean as soon as it is collected, because rainwater and reservoir water are already safe to drink. What is the best correction?

choices.text: The student is right - clear-looking water is safe to drink
Collected water is raw water, not tap water: it must be drawn to the treatment works and cleaned stage by stage before it is stored and piped to home taps.
The water is cleaned by being stored in the reservoir
The pipes clean the water on its way to homes

questions.misconception: Tap water is clean as soon as it is collected, because rainwater and reservoir water are already safe to drink.
questions.feedback: If you agreed with the student, that is the trap: Tap water is clean as soon as it is collected, because rainwater and reservoir water are already safe to drink. Reteach point: Collected water is raw water, not tap water: it is drawn from the reservoir to the treatment works, where treatment stages remove dirt and germs step by step, and only the cleaned water is stored and piped to home taps.

questions.prompt: In one sentence, explain why reservoir water is called raw water.
questions.answer: It is called raw water because it has been collected but not yet treated - it still carries dirt and germs and is not safe to drink.
questions.feedback: A strong answer names what raw water still carries - dirt and germs - and that no treatment stage has removed them yet.

questions.prompt: In the final stage, the water that reaches home taps is water that has:

choices.text: Just been collected in the reservoir
Been cleaned at the treatment works, then stored and piped to homes
Travelled through pipes for a long time
Stood in the reservoir until it looked clear

questions.feedback: Scene 4 shows the cleaned water leaving storage and travelling the pipe to the home - treated first, then stored and piped.

questions.prompt: In one sentence, state the final stage of the water supply and the stages that came before it.
questions.answer: The final stage is clean water stored and piped to home taps, and it came after rain was collected in a reservoir, the raw water was drawn to the treatment works, and treatment cleaned it stage by stage.
questions.feedback: A strong answer gives the whole order - reservoir, treatment works, cleaned stage by stage, stored and piped home - with no stage skipped.
